body.purpose: Forms, tables, descriptions, and working content.

title.purpose: Page titles and principal section headings.

label.purpose: Field labels, metadata, badges, and table headings.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, navigation, progress, and short state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Affirmative inventory action with restrained emerald emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#059669; color:#ffffff; padding:8px 16px; font:600 14px/1.25 Cairo, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-in-out; }.ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#047857; }.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset:2px; }.ds-btn-primary:active { background:#065f46; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default inventory form field with a quiet slate border and clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#1e293b; font:600 12px/1.25 Cairo, sans-serif; direction:rtl; }.ds-input { width:100%; min-height:40px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:8px; background:#ffffff; color:#1e293b; padding:8px 12px; font:400 14px/1.5 Cairo, sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-in-out; }.ds-input::placeholder { color:#64748b; }.ds-input:focus { border-color:#059669; outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(5,150,105,0.18); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact success status badge for active or completed records.
components.css: .ds-chip-success { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#d1fae5; color:#065f46; padding:2px 10px; font:700 12px/1.25 Cairo, sans-serif; }

components.name: Dashboard Navigation
components.description: Right-aligned sidebar navigation with an emerald active destination.
components.html: المخزونبوت الواتساب
components.css: .ds-nav { width:220px; display:grid; gap:8px; direction:rtl; background:#0f172a; padding:16px; }.ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; border-radius:8px; color:#cbd5e1; padding:12px 16px; font:600 14px/1.25 Cairo, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 150ms ease-in-out, color 150ms ease-in-out; }.ds-nav-link:hover { background:#1e293b; color:#ffffff; }.ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset:2px; }.ds-nav-active { background:#059669; color:#ffffff; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Light operational panel with quiet border and subtle panel lift.
components.html:
قائمة المخزون

الأصناف والكمية والحالة الحالية.
components.css: .ds-panel { direction:rtl; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; background:#ffffff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.05); padding:24px; }.ds-panel-title { margin:0 0 8px; color:#1e293b; font:700 20px/1.3 Cairo, sans-serif; }.ds-panel-copy { margin:0; color:#64748b; font:400 14px/1.5 Cairo, sans-serif; }

components.name: Import Progress
components.description: Indigo import progress pattern used for background Excel workflows.
components.css: .ds-import { direction:rtl; border:1px solid #c7d2fe; border-radius:12px; background:#eef2ff; padding:16px; font:600 14px/1.25 Cairo, sans-serif; }.ds-import-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; color:#312e81; margin-bottom:8px; }.ds-import-track { height:12px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:9999px; background:#e0e7ff; }.ds-import-bar { width:60%; height:100%; border-radius:9999px; background:#4f46e5; transition:width 150ms ease-in-out; }

narrative.overview:
The incumbent interface is a practical Arabic RTL operations workspace. It favors readable data, familiar controls, and low-friction task completion over visual spectacle. Surfaces are light, borders are quiet, navigation is persistent, and status is communicated with restrained semantic color.

The character is refined and restrained: compact enough for daily work, but with clear spacing and a consistent component vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Clean light surfaces on a cool slate-neutral page
Emerald actions and selection with indigo reserved for import tools
Consistent rounded panels, inputs, tables, and buttons
Desktop task density with responsive collapse rather than fluid typography

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Emerald leads actions and current location; indigo is reserved for import tools, and neutral surfaces remain visually dominant.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display or script faces into inventory UI; headings, controls, labels, and data stay in the product’s established sans-serif family.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Borders define normal surfaces; shadows appear only when a panel must visually lift or an overlay must escape the page.

dos: Preserve the Arabic RTL structure and existing terminology.
Use direct, concise Arabic action labels beside familiar inventory concepts.
Keep tables and data values easy to scan with consistent alignment and semantic status color.
Use emerald for primary affirmative actions and current inventory navigation.
Use slate borders and tonal surfaces before introducing shadow.
Preserve keyboard focus, error recovery, loading feedback, and mobile overflow behavior.
donts: Introduce an unrequested visual world, hero treatment, or marketing-style layout.
Mix emoji, ornamental icons, and line-icon systems; use the existing controls and symbols consistently.
Replace familiar forms and table affordances with decorative cards or custom widgets.
Use a display font, oversized heading, gradient text, or saturated inactive state.
Color every section with a different accent; reserve indigo and semantic colors for their workflows.
Delete or weaken established permission, validation, and data-integrity behavior during visual refinement.
